text: England beat New Zealand 37-12 at Twickenham, their biggest win over the All Blacks, and meet them again on 28 November in the Nations Championship finals weekend.
Kansas City Current beat Washington Spirit 2-1 to win their first NWSL title, Debinha scoring in stoppage time and the Spirit losing a third straight final.
Michael van Gerwen and Tom Sykes both hit nine-darters in their Grand Slam of Darts quarter-final, which van Gerwen won to reach an all-Dutch semi-final with Gian van Veen.
The Grand Slam of Curling National in Sydney, Nova Scotia reaches its finals on Sunday, and Rachel Homan, who has four titles there, opened with a win.
The 2-8 Jets, who have lost five straight, visit the 1-8 Chargers on Sunday at 4:05 PM New York time.
